answer: The mirror register is checked at draw time, terrace lists the eligible set, and hollow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 82 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 82 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
